definitions.explanation: Areas or places outside the borders of one's country. Used to describe things, activities, or movements beyond national boundaries.

examples.japanese: {国外|こくがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃亡|とうぼう}する→逃亡する：26871_toubousuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国外|こくがい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This product is also sold overseas.

examples.japanese: {国外|こくがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧ことで、⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The economy grew significantly due to an increase in foreign investment.

notes:
Composed of {国|こく} (country) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). A straightforward compound indicating areas beyond one's national borders. Can function as a noun or as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国外|こくがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go abroad
- {国外|こくがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃亡|とうぼう}する→逃亡する：26871_toubousuru⟧: to flee the country
- {国外|こくがい}⟦{追放|ついほう}→追放：14313_tsuihou⟧: deportation, banishment
- {国外|こくがい}⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧: departure from the country
- {国外|こくがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧: imports from abroad

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧: inside the country, domestic — the opposite
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧: overseas, abroad — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧: foreign country — refers to a specific other country
- {国外|こくがい} vs ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧: {国外|こくがい} is more formal and often appears in legal/official contexts; ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧ is more colloquial
